verdict: Strong 28-day organic performance, with engagement softening in the final week.

In the final 7 days, however, GBP engagement dropped 26% compared to the prior 7 days, pointing to a softening in organic search visibility across both Canton and Fishers. The two most recent days show no recorded actions, which appears to be a data feed delay rather than a true drop, and that number will be confirmed once the feed catches up. We're monitoring both profiles closely and will address any visibility signals as they firm up next week.
